articles.title: Sync by 50 wireless headphones review
articles.subtitle: Solid sound, questionable app
articles.excerpt: Apple Watch review: Design. For a slightly more opinionated version of the video review above, here's the male half of the team...
articles.author: admin

content.text: Wireless headphones have come a long way, and the Sync by 50 line is a solid mid-tier entry with punchy bass and a comfortable over-ear fit.

content.alt: Sync by 50 headphones on a table

content.text: Bass-forward tuning dominates, which suits hip-hop and EDM listeners well, though it can feel a touch overwhelming for acoustic tracks.
The companion app is functional but clunky, with an EQ panel that resets more often than it should. Firmware updates have been inconsistent.
Great for the gym, less great for critical listening.
Battery life easily clears a full day of commuting and workouts, and the case doubles as a decent power bank in a pinch.

articles.title: Battle of the portable planar magnetic headphones
articles.subtitle: Two contenders, one clear winner
articles.excerpt: Apple Watch review: Design. For a slightly more opinionated version of the video review above, here's the male half of the team...
articles.author: admin

content.text: Planar magnetic drivers used to mean bulky over-ear cans tethered to a desktop amp. Not anymore — two portable contenders go head to head.

content.alt: Two planar magnetic headphones side by side

content.text: Both pairs deliver the signature planar clarity, but differ meaningfully in comfort during long sessions and in how forgiving they are of poorly mastered tracks.

articles.title: Bragi Headphone review: finally, wireless earbuds worth buying
articles.subtitle: The true wireless category grows up
articles.excerpt: Apple Watch review: Design. For a slightly more opinionated version of the video review above, here's the male half of the team...
articles.author: admin

content.text: Early true wireless earbuds were a mixed bag — dropouts, poor fit, and battery life measured in minutes. Bragi's latest pair finally addresses most of that.
Connection stability is the headline improvement here, with barely a hiccup across several days of daily commuting and gym use.
